The aforesaid detenu Zinnat, son of Motaleb Pramanik, Village-Birahimpur, Police Station Peergonj under District-Rangpur at present residing at 45/2, Eskaton Hoque Shaheb-er-Mess, under Police Station Ramna, District-Dhaka now detained in Dhaka Central Jail, Dhaka was arrested by police. The District Magistrate, Dhaka passed an initial order of detention detaining the detenu for a period of 30 days under section 3(2) of the Special Powers Act, 1974 vide order in Misc. Case No.156/96, dated 20-1-96 and initially the grounds of detention was not served upon the detenu within the statutory period of 15 days. However the grounds of detention was served upon the detenu on 4-2-96 as required under section 8(2) of the Special Powers Act, 1974. The detention order of the detenu was approved by the government so passed by the District Magistrate and extended the period of detention for a further period of 3 months vide memo No. 706—Sha:Ma:(Nira-3) dated 6-2-96 purportedly signed by a Senior Assistant Secretary (Security) from 19-2-96. 

 5. In view of such facts and circumstances it has been further held that in a number of decisions of this Court that the Government is not empowered to extend the period of detention under section 3(3) of the Special Powers Act so passed by the District Magistrate. Accordingly, we hold and find that the detention of the detenu on and from the date of passing the initial order of detention i.e. 20-1-96 is illegal and accordingly, the Rule is made absolute. We therefore directed the authority to release the detenu at once if not wanted in connection with any other case.
